tier_basis: no structyear; land-use descriptions

tier_basis: no structyear (0 on every parcel); land-use descriptions

tier_basis: structyear 100% of built homes; land-use labels separate townhouse, condo, 2-4 and 5+ units

tier_basis: structyear 100% of built homes in the six towns (Charlotte and the county remainder are held out, so not checked); building-type codes

tier_basis: structyear 100% of RES parcels, but RES lumps every housing type: coded tier 2 (use codes too coarse), confirmed by Ben 2026-10-20
notes: parusedesc has eight coarse classes (RES lumps every housing type and vacant lots). improvval is 0 on every parcel, so a building is read from structyear > 0
